'''2000 Tol-Con tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held at Tol-Con, Toledo, Ohio on 21 October 2000. [[Brad Eier]] won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1367">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-21-tol-con-toledo-ohio-10-21-00d1367/ tol-con-toledo-ohio-10-21-00], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 21 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-21-tol-con-toledo-ohio-10-21-00d1367/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Tol-Con, Toledo, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Eier]]
